assertions.assertion: The claim is a CO-197 denial.
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring).
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The dizziness and giddiness are coded R42.
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The ordering note states the rationale for the mobile cardiac telemetry order.
The denial is a precertification denial.
The appeal is directed to SilverBridge.
